purpose: Define the review camera angles and pre-join acceptance language for humanoid head control variants.

views.review_role: Checks brow, sockets, nose, mouth, jaw, and symmetry from the most readable character view.
Checks whether face plates wrap around the skull instead of reading as a flat mask.
Checks skull, brow, nose, lips, chin, jaw, and ear side silhouette.
Mirrors the side-read check and catches accidental asymmetry.
Checks whether separate plates are embedded around the head volume before any join pass.

join_readiness_language.numeric_precheck_passed: QC passed and all requested views rendered, but visual approval is still required before head_join_strategy_v0.
join_readiness_language.needs_fix_before_join: Do not join yet; fix controls, measurements, or compiler placement first.
